concerns.text: T003 states fallback check runs 'BEFORE any filtering' but does not explicitly sequence it before the listen-threshold filter. EC-001 requires the check on the RAW cohort before FR-009 filtering. Add explicit step ordering: (1) load raw cohort, (2) compute missing_pct, (3) trigger fallback if >50%, (4) THEN apply listen threshold.

T004 claims to consolidate the prior duplicate T025 'join_exposure_data' into a single implementation, but the description does not explicitly state WHERE in the T004 workflow this join occurs relative to cue matching and aggregation. Clarify: does join happen after match_cues, before aggregate_to_user_track, or elsewhere? The prior duplicate suggests ambiguity about the join's position in the pipeline.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 & T004 vs plan.md:Complexity Tracking & data-model.md
concerns.text: T003 specifies 'raw adolescent_exposure_ratio = adolescent_listens / total_listens, no logit' but plan.md Complexity Tracking and data-model.md both describe logit transformation. This contradicts spec.md FR-001 which explicitly forbids pre-transformation. Tasks must commit to ONE approach: raw ratio (per spec) or logit-transformed (per plan). Current state leaves implementation ambiguous.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 vs spec.md:FR-005 & plan.md:FR/SC Coverage Map
concerns.text: T006 implements 'fit_mixed_model' with formula 'mean_vividness ~ adolescent_exposure_ratio + popularity + (1|user_id)' per spec FR-005, but plan.md's FR/SC Coverage Map states the model will fit 'mean_vividness ~ logit(ratio) + popularity + (1|user_id)'. Task description must match either spec (raw ratio) or plan (logit). Resolve the logit contradiction before implementation.

T007 states 're-calculate raw exposure for the matched track subset' during sensitivity analysis, implying the exposure ratio is recomputed per threshold. However, spec.md FR-006 does not explicitly state whether the ratio itself is recalculated or only the cue matching is re-done. Clarify in T007 whether the adolescent_exposure_ratio is recomputed for each threshold or held constant from T003.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-008 & plan.md:FR/SC Coverage Map
concerns.text: T003 states fallback calculates global exposure 'streamed from the full population' but does not specify whether this is the real MSD or the simulated population. spec.md FR-008 references 'Million Song Dataset' but plan.md explicitly uses synthetic data. T003 must clarify: does the fallback use real MSD metadata or the simulated population? If simulated, update spec.md Section 6 to document this.

T010 and T011 are both marked [P] (parallel-safe) and listed in Phase 4, but T011 explicitly requires artifacts from T003–T006 (Phase 2–3). The [P] tag on T010 is acceptable (verification is independent), but T011 cannot run in parallel with T010 if T010 depends on T003–T006 completing first. Either remove [P] from T011 or add an explicit hard dependency: 'T011 must run after T006 completes.'

T011 is described as a contract test for 'data/processed/user_track_pairs.parquet and data/final/regression_summary.csv' but regression_summary.csv is not produced until T006 (modeling). The task says 'Run with pytest... after T003–T006 have produced the artifacts' but does not enforce this ordering in the task definition itself. Add an explicit prerequisite list: 'Requires: T003, T004, T006' to prevent accidental early execution.

Phase 2 is titled 'Data ingestion, exposure scoring, and aggregation (US-001, US-002)' but T005 (orchestrator) is also listed in Phase 2 and covers US-003. Clarify: does T005 belong in Phase 2 or Phase 3? If it orchestrates the full flow (ingest → model → verify), it should be listed separately or Phase 2 should be retitled to include US-003.

T001 states 'Verified by executing the documented command path' but does not specify WHAT command or WHERE it is documented. Reference the exact section of quickstart.md that contains the runnable command, or clarify that quickstart.md is produced by a later task (T010 mentions 'compile report.md' but not quickstart.md generation).

T009 states 'Generate diagnostic plots to data/final/plots/' but T010 (Verify artifacts) is listed as a separate task. The ordering implies T009 runs before T010, but T009 is not explicitly listed as a prerequisite for T010. Clarify whether T010's verification includes checking that all plots in T009 were generated, or if T009 is independent.
